name: Impermanent
description: Impermanent is a live benchmark for evaluating temporal generalization in time series forecasting. It scores forecasts sequentially over time on continuously updated data streams, enabling the study of temporal robustness, distributional shift, and performance stability rather than one-off accuracy on a static test set.
reputation: A very recent live benchmark from the paper introducing it, so it has little established community adoption yet.
notes: Focuses on live, continuously updated evaluation to avoid contamination and measure sustained performance over time.
